|game_text='''0 side — The Hidden Path'''

Deploy Mining Village, Safehouse, Underground Corridor, and Fallen Order. For remainder of game, you may not deploy &lt;&gt; locations or Jedi (except Jedi survivors). Weapon Levitation may not steal weapons. Once per turn, may ▼ a Jabiim location. While this side up, you may not play Nabrun Leids. Your Force drains at Mapuzo sites are -1. Once per turn, may ▼ a holocron. Flip this card if Jedi occupy two non-Mapuzo sites.

'''7 side — Gather Allies And Train'''

While this side up, Jedi survivors are deploy -1. If your holocron is about to leave table, place it in Used Pile. Opponent's total battle destiny where they have a character of ability &gt; 4 is -1. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Jedi between a Jabiim site and a battleground site as a regular move. At the end of your turn, if Jedi occupy two battleground sites, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Jedi do not occupy two sites.

* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 26 December 2025: “'''0 side — The Hidden Path''' Deploy Mining Village, Safehouse, Underground Corridor, and Fallen Order. For remainder of game, you may not deploy &lt;&gt; locations or Jedi (except Jedi survivors). Weapon Levitation may not steal weapons. Once per turn, may ▼ a Jabiim location. While this side up, you may not play Nabrun Leids. Your Force drains at Mapuzo sites are -1. Once per turn, may ▼ a holocron. Flip this card if Jedi occupy two non-Mapuzo sites. '''7 side — Gather Allies And Train''' While this side up, Jedi survivors are deploy -1. If your holocron is about to leave table, place it in Used Pile. Opponent's total battle destiny where they have a character of ability &gt; 4 is -1. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Jedi between a Jabiim site and a battleground site as a regular move. At the end of your turn, if Jedi occupy two battleground sites, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Jedi do not occupy two sites.” '''What changed:''' Changed words: the slip is the first publication of the wording of the card image [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), which the PC published after the sheet. Game text: “Weapon Levitation may not steal weapons.” was added; “site or a battleground (except a Kamino, Tatooine, or [Reflections III] location).” became “location.”; “if” became “Jedi survivors are deploy -1. If”; “Your lightsaber Force drain bonuses may not be canceled.” was dropped; “use 2 Force to” was added; “move for free.” became “move.”; “if Jedi occupy two battleground sites,” was added; “you” became “Jedi”; “sites with Jedi.” became “sites.”. The sheet PDF was created at 07:04 UTC on 26 December 2025, before the card image [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata 2)]] was uploaded (01:21 UTC, 27 December 2025). Under the label “The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train” the sheet prints, pixel for pixel, the card image that the PC uploaded shortly afterwards as [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata 2)]] (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). The two sides are printed as two slips (page 4). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints “E1”.

* '''PC-E3''' ([[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata 3)]]): PC card images of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-hp-3">PC card images in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/thehiddenpath.gif thehiddenpath.gif], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/gatheralliesandtrain.gif gatheralliesandtrain.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f23e07 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E2”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E2”): The Hidden Path adds “Anakin,” and “or play A Jedi's Resilience” to the deploy restriction; Gather Allies And Train's Force loss is “At the end of opponent's turn” (was “your turn”) and its flip condition is “two non-Mapuzo sites” (was “two sites”). Text: “The Hidden Path: Deploy Mining Village, Safehouse, Underground Corridor, and Fallen Order. For remainder of game, you may not deploy <> locations, Anakin, or Jedi (except Jedi survivors) or play A Jedi's Resilience. Weapon Levitation may not steal weapons. Once per turn, may ▼ a Jabiim location. While this side up, you may not play Nabrun Leids. Your Force drains at Mapuzo sites are -1. Once per turn, may ▼ a holocron. Flip this card if Jedi occupy two non-Mapuzo sites. Gather Allies And Train: While this side up, Jedi survivors are deploy -1. If your holocron is about to leave table, place it in Used Pile. Opponent's total battle destiny where they have a character of ability > 4 is -1. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Jedi between a Jabiim site and a battleground site as a regular move. At the end of opponent's turn, if Jedi occupy two battleground sites, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Jedi do not occupy two non-Mapuzo sites.”
